supersedes.reason: Independent review: the end-of-quarantine retirement also retires session-policy leases, so the claim that no admitted request is refused was wrong; two test gaps.

reviewFixes: 7d1c2500 corrects the guard header, pins admission-before-snapshot and adds the real-app suite
77ae50e4 corrects ADR 0072's follow-on guard wording and the checkpoint

guard.quarantineEnd: first admission after the end runs the app's full local retirement once (session-policy leases included); UserRevision's epoch and tokens are kept
guard.sessionEffect: A session-policy request in flight at that instant can fail once with 409 session_policy_changed, or a 500 where SESSION_RESOLUTION_STALE is uncaught, as after any full local retirement.
guard.startupRecord: chart_cache_cohort_start: sourceRevision, userCacheEnabled, writerSetVersion, quarantineMs, quarantineEndsAt; flag-on processes only
guard.flagOff: every entry point is a no-op
guard.acceptedResidual: Background writers are not held until healthy; accepted for source only, and the activation review must accept it again or a later slice must hold them.

independentReview.note: Fixed: the session-lease claim (docs plus a real-app test) and the admission-order test gap. Documented as limitations: the wall-clock quarantine and default-open retention outside server.js.

retained: Round one placed the quarantine decision as a ternary in send, raising its strict complexity from 31 to 32; the decision passes into the key helper since round two.
boundaries: Single-process tests: no real rolling deploy, provider health or signal timing, or shutdown bound; those are receipt observations.
Exact-head CI, merge, deployment and production acceptance remain pending.
USER_CACHE_ENABLED stays off; G1-G3 stay unmet. No activation, latency, request-reduction or savings claim.
